title: Morris Park and New Orleans visitors: Edmund Hall, Buddy Petit, Lee Collins
summary: Allen asks about Morris Park and New Orleans musicians who played there, such as Edmund Hall, Buddy Petit and Lee Collins.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You ever been to Morris Park?
Say pardon?
Have you ever been to Morris Park?
Morris Park?
They were run by Dr. Brunswick and Aaron Long.
Oh, that's, you mean, out here, too. Dr. Cobb, isn't it?
I guess it is.
It's Dr. Cobb, yeah, something out there.
Where Thomas Mack plays.
Yes, uh-huh. That's Dr. Cobb running that place out there. It was running that only one of them. It's been years ago.
I believe Edmund Hall or Manuel Sales told me about that. You remember Edmund Hall?
Yeah.
Tall, lanky fellow plays clarinet. And he was down here first with Buddy Petit. You remember Buddy?
Yeah, I know Buddy Petit. You know all of them.
He was here first with Buddy.
It says so.
And then he came back with Thomas Mack. I believe, or Lee Collins. I can't remember.
Lee Collins.
You remember Lee?
I know. I remember Lee Collins.
He passed, you know.
Did he?
Lee hasn't been that long.
And Bill Bina, he passed, too. He came down with Mack, too.
